Name: TC_PIM_ADDEMPLOYEE_003(negative/security): Verify non-admin user is restricted from accessing the Add Employee feature
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS

1. Stable internet connection.

2. Use environment: Windows 11 / Google Chrome v149.

3. Access URL:

4. Use standard ESS credentials:

o Username: ess.user

o Password: ess_password123

5. User is currently on their default dashboard screen.

REQUIREMENTS

1. TC_AUTH_LOGIN_006(Positive): Verify successful login with valid
standard ESS credentials.
Objective:
This test case verifies that a registered standard user with ESS (Employee
Self Service) privileges does not have access to administrative operations,
ensuring proper access control and role isolation.
Step:
Locate and inspect the left-side main navigation menu on the dashboard
view.
Expected Result:
The "PIM" module is either completely hidden from the menu viewport, or if
visible, the "Add Employee" sub-tab/button is strictly omitted from the
graphical UI layout.

Name: TC_PIM_008(usability): Verify visual organization of employee reports

registered).

to the dashboard
